atlas_recommendation.executive_summary: The business is healthy but the pipeline is idle. Your highest-value hour today is spent on two decisions: approving the next outreach campaign direction (unlocking 122 prospects) and signing off on QPaint Email 2 (progressing a $570K recovery pipeline). Together they take under 30 minutes. The three QPaint replacement emails are a quick third priority — 10 minutes to review, then Atlas handles the scheduling.

priorities.action: Approve the next outreach campaign direction
priorities.why_it_matters: 122 new prospects have been sitting idle since July 30. Every day without a campaign is a day the pipeline doesn't move. The Travis case study is our highest-evidence asset — it converted 2 out of 2 prospects who reached Email 3. Moving it to Email 1 tests whether we can compress the conversion window from 10–14 days down to 1–5 days.
priorities.expected_impact: Unlocks the entire prospect pipeline. New experiments generate learning velocity. Even a 2% conversion rate on 122 prospects = 2–3 new clients.
priorities.confidence: High (90%+) — strong July evidence supports Travis at Email 1

priorities.action: Approve QPaint Email 2 and the three Dineo Ndala replacement emails
